issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 default 渲 150f，比镜头本意 160f 少 10f，收尾静止被截掉
Courier New 粗体压在灰平底上，像打字机字体的截图，没有产品字卡的质感
光标是 7px 纯墨色竖条，和字同色，犹豫段的两闪不够醒目
改口打完就结束，宣言词 "command center" 和平庸的 "just" 没有任何主次，结尾一帧没有落点
整行孤零零悬在画面中央，没有上下文
changes: 导出 TYPEWRITER_ERROR_RETYPE_DURATION = 160；三档速度（打 2f / 删 1.5f / 重打 1.5f）与光标三态时间表一帧不动，f110 后静止 50f
改用等宽字体 100px / 600 字重、60px 固定槽，最终句整体居中、左缘锚定不横移；柔光底配颗粒
光标改成 6px 强调色圆角竖条带淡辉光，犹豫与完稿的闪烁一眼可见
打完的同时（f96–110，与完稿两闪并行）一道强调色马克笔底色从左到右铺到 "command center" 下半身，给宣言一个落定
行上方加一行与左缘对齐的 34px 灰色眉题 "Introducing Acme Console"，开场 10f 淡入
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench rendered the 150f default, 10f short of the intended 160f, which cut off the closing hold
Bold Courier New on a flat gray ground looked like a screenshot of a typewriter font, not a product title card
The cursor was a 7px solid ink bar in the same color as the text, so the two hesitation blinks barely registered
Once the retype finished, nothing set the payoff words "command center" apart from the plain "just", so the final frame had no focal point
The single line floated alone in the middle of the frame with no context
changesEn: Exported TYPEWRITER_ERROR_RETYPE_DURATION = 160; the three speeds (type 2f / delete 1.5f / retype 1.5f) and the three-state cursor timeline are unchanged frame for frame, with 50f of stillness after f110
Switched to a 100px monospace at weight 600 in fixed 60px slots; the final sentence is centered and left-anchored so it never shifts sideways, on a soft-lit background with grain
The cursor is now a 6px rounded accent bar with a faint glow, so the hesitation and completion blinks read at a glance
As typing completes (f96–110, alongside the two completion blinks), an accent marker band sweeps left to right under the lower half of "command center" to land the payoff
Added a 34px gray kicker, "Introducing Acme Console", aligned to the line's left edge and fading in over the first 10f
